_note: Training sources per crop for scripts/train_crop_model.py. Paths are relative to root. Each class needs its own folder. Use original images only (no pre-rotated copies) so the validation split has no near-duplicates of training images. Run python -m scripts.inspect_source_datasets to see folders, then fill 'classes'. Set source and license from the dataset's own page; training refuses license TO_VERIFY unless --accept-unverified-license is passed, and the model card records it.

wheat._warning: NWRD_DATA is a wheat-rust segmentation set (images + masks). It has one disease class, so it cannot train a disease classifier on its own.
